# floor-refuses-below-cost

A photo scan costs 2p and a live lookup 1.31p (the seeded cost bases). The lowest rate a credit
is sold at is Max yearly, 0.2771p net, so at the seeded 2x margin a photo scan needs at least
15 credits and a lookup at least 10. Dropping them to 10 and 9 credits is refused; 10 credits for
a lookup clears the floor (2.771p against 2.62p) and is saved and priced at once.
